Title: 2023-10-23 PTR Patch
Subtitle: === General ===
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Updates]
  User Interface:
  • Floating text display for Experience on last-hit updated from purple to golden.
  Observer:
  • Experience Globes will now be displayed as blue for the team on the left and grey for the team on the right.
  • The top interface has been updated to display Misha's Health.
  • The top interface has been updated to display Olaf, Baleog, and Erik's Health.
  Gameplay:
  • Abilities that bounce will require all targets to be visible.
  • Abilities that cleave will reveal the area and not require target to be visible.
  • Abilities that splash will reveal the area and not require target to be visible.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused ARAM to use different Experience systems.

[Bug Fixes]
